source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Enable amdgpu RAS, run a source UMC baseline query, issue one AMDGPU-RAS block-1/sub-block-0/type-4 injection, and require an SDMA uncorrectable ACA event followed by GPU MODE1 reset, resume and VRAM-object recovery.
procedure_facts: Run `amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -q 1` and require zero UMC errors.
Collect full results and check dmesg/syslog/SEL.
criteria_facts: Tool reports Device 0, block sdma(1), sub-block sdma_mbank_data_buf0_sed(0), type 4 and successful injection.
Kernel records one new SDMA uncorrectable event with ACA fields.
Kernel performs GPU MODE1 reset, resumes the driver, reports VRAM loss and shadow recovery, and ends with reset success.
source_conflicts: The procedure describes the injection as `address/command parity`, which is a UMC-style description, while the item, block 1 command and expected output identify an SDMA data-buffer uncorrectable event.
The only explicit pre-query checks UMC block 0, not the target SDMA block 1, so it cannot establish a clean SDMA baseline.
The injection command omits `-d 0` even though expected output says Device 0; the tool's default-device behavior is not stated.
missing_source_information: AMDGPU-RAS tool version and signed block/sub-block/type/device semantics for the exact ASIC/driver/firmware.
Mapping of tool device/default to GPU UUID, PCI BDF, serial/OAM/socket/die and Linux DRM card/render nodes.
Actual loaded-driver `ras_enable`/`ras_mask`/SDMA feature state and safe activation plan if not enabled at load time.
SDMA CE/UE baseline and expected +1 rule; whether literal ACA STATUS/ADDR/MISC/IPID/SYND and socket values are fixed or example-only.
Allowed reset path, reset timeout, workload/VRAM loss policy, final GPU functionality and reboot recovery.

original_test_intent.statement: Inject exactly one approved SDMA sub-block type-4 uncorrectable error into the mapped AMD GPU, prove the event is attributed to the intended SDMA target, and verify the driver executes the expected GPU reset/resume and restores usable GPU state after the intentional VRAM-loss path.
must_preserve: AMD GPU and in-band AMDGPU-RAS execution.
SDMA block 1, sub-block 0, type 4 semantics after version-specific confirmation.
The source UMC zero query as a separate baseline fact, without mislabeling it SDMA evidence.
One injection and a fresh SDMA uncorrectable/ACA record.
Expected GPU reset, resume, VRAM-loss/shadow-recovery sequence and final health.
must_not_infer: That the prose `address/command parity` defines the same fault as the SDMA output.
That a zero UMC counter proves the SDMA baseline is zero.
That rerunning `modprobe` changes `ras_enable` on an already loaded driver.
That example BDF 0000:0c:00.0, SocketId 2, ACA values or reset messages apply unchanged to another ASIC/driver.
That `Error Inject Successfully` alone proves reset recovery or usable GPU state.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly restores the source's SDMA/ACA/reset/VRAM evidence, rejects a generic dmesg tail and requires a dedicated SUT, target approval and recovery.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 treats the UMC query as the required zero baseline without adding an SDMA baseline, assumes `modprobe ... ras_enable=1` establishes runtime state, and does not elevate the address/command-parity prose or omitted device selector to explicit source conflicts.

related_records: Other AMD UMC, GFX or SDMA cases cannot supply this row's exact ASIC/tool mapping or justify reusing their block/type semantics.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The item, command block and detailed expected SDMA output outweigh the inconsistent address/command-parity phrase, but V3 records the conflict and requires AMD/FAE confirmation rather than silently rewriting it.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep the approval-gated classification but block injection until the owner confirms this is SDMA rather than UMC parity, binds the command/default device to a unique GPU and proves RAS state. Preserve the UMC query while adding a target SDMA UE baseline and delta; do not accept literal example ACA/BDF values across platforms.

conditions_present: Candidate driver parameter, source tool commands, intended SDMA block/sub-block/type, UMC query, expected uncorrectable event, reset/resume and VRAM recovery pattern are supplied.
missing: Fault-description resolution, tool/ASIC semantics, explicit GPU mapping/default behavior, loaded RAS state, SDMA baseline/delta, expected ACA/reset matrix, final health, timeout and recovery.
provider: AMD/ODM GPU-RAS owner supplies the signed ASIC/tool/driver/firmware recipe and resolves SDMA versus parity wording.
Platform owner maps tool device to UUID/BDF/serial/OAM/socket/die and defines reset/health expectations.
Lab owner approves workload evacuation, one-shot injection and OOB/reboot recovery.
safe_read_only_work: Record GPU UUID/BDF/serial/OAM/DRM-node, ASIC, VBIOS, driver, firmware and tool identities.
Read `/sys/module/amdgpu/parameters/ras_enable`, `ras_mask`, per-GPU RAS feature exposure and UMC plus SDMA CE/UE counters without injection.
Preserve full kernel journal cursor, dmesg, SEL, GPU health/topology and active-client baseline before any clearing or module action.
prohibited_until_resolved: Driver unload/reload, workload termination, log clearing, injection command, reset/reboot, implicit default-device use, automatic retry or PASS.
closure_evidence: Signed recipe confirms block1/subblock0/type4 is this SDMA UE and specifies the exact tool device selector/default behavior.
Unique GPU mapping, loaded RAS/SDMA support and both UMC and SDMA baseline counters are recorded.
Expected per-version ACA/reset/VRAM/final-health matrix, one-shot approval, timeout and recovery are ready.

revision_candidate.test_name: Validate AMD GPU SDMA Type-4 Uncorrectable Error Recovery
revision_candidate.purpose: Inject exactly one approved SDMA block-1/sub-block-0/type-4 uncorrectable event into one uniquely mapped AMD GPU, verify a fresh target-correlated SDMA/ACA record and UE-count delta, and prove the prescribed GPU reset, driver resume, VRAM recovery handling and final GPU usability.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Only the AMD ASIC, VBIOS, amdgpu driver/firmware and AMDGPU-RAS tool version in the signed recipe. Execute on the host OS against the GPU mapped by UUID/BDF/serial/OAM and tool device selector; example Device 0 or BDF values are not portable defaults.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One uniquely mapped GPU, SDMA block 1, signed sub-block 0 and type 4, one injection and its reset/recovery sequence. The source UMC block-0 query is a separate baseline control and does not replace SDMA evidence. Other GPUs, UMC parity faults, other SDMA instances/types and repeated injections are out of scope. Treat 30/30 minutes as estimates.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: SUT/GPU UUID/BDF/serial/OAM/socket/die/DRM-node map; ASIC/VBIOS/driver/firmware/tool versions; signed meaning of `-b 1 -s 0 -t 4`; explicit device selector or documented default; resolution of `address/command parity` versus SDMA; loaded `ras_enable`, `ras_mask` and SDMA feature state; safe driver activation plan if needed; UMC and SDMA CE/UE baselines; expected SDMA delta and ACA fields for this version; expected MODE1/reset/VRAM messages and timeout; workload isolation/VRAM-loss policy; final GPU diagnostic; reboot/OOB recovery; approval and evidence storage.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve identities, mappings, full logs, UMC/SDMA counters and GPU health. Inspect the already loaded amdgpu parameters/features; do not assume a repeated modprobe changes them. If RAS activation requires a load/boot change, use a separately approved no-workload driver/boot procedure, then revalidate mapping and health. Retain the source `amdgpuras -d 0 -b 0 -q 1` UMC query when Device 0 is the signed target, but also require a zero/approved SDMA UE baseline from its supported counter/interface. After one-shot approval, run the exact injection with an explicit device selector if supported, or only after the tool's Device-0 default is proven. Capture complete tool output and kernel journal from injection through SDMA ACA event, UE delta, reset begin/MODE1/resume, VRAM-loss/shadow handling and final reset result. Run the owner-defined GPU function/health check and compare all evidence with the versioned matrix.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Dedicated non-production SUT; all GPU workloads/clients evacuated; exact GPU/tool target and SDMA semantics signed; driver RAS/SDMA feature active and verified; UMC source query and SDMA UE baseline acceptable; full log cursor and health baseline preserved; GPU reset/reboot/OOB recovery tested; stable power; one-shot approval immediately before injection.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: SUT/GPU identity map; ASIC/VBIOS/driver/firmware/tool versions; actual ras_enable/ras_mask/SDMA feature state; active-client isolation; source UMC baseline plus target SDMA CE/UE baseline; exact device/block/sub-block/type command and tool-reported UUID/BDF/device mapping; `Error Inject Successfully`; fresh target SDMA uncorrectable/ACA event, decoded fields and SDMA UE delta; version-approved socket/die attribution; timestamped reset begin, MODE1/SMU/PSP/driver resume and VRAM-loss/shadow recovery sequence; final reset result; full journal/dmesg/SEL; no error storm or wrong GPU impact; final GPU enumeration, memory/compute/telemetry health; recovery actions and engineer disposition.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The signed AMD/ODM recipe for the exact ASIC, tool and driver. Pass requires one correct target/type injection, fresh SDMA UE/ACA attribution and counter delta, the prescribed reset/resume/VRAM handling without disallowed mismatch, no persistent error storm, and the owner-defined final GPU health. The source's literal BDF/SocketId/ACA values are examples unless the target recipe confirms them; tool success or UMC baseline alone is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not run on production or with active GPU clients; treat a UMC counter as SDMA baseline; assume Device 0/default targeting; inject address/command parity instead of SDMA; reload/unbind amdgpu without a plan; clear logs before preserving them; reuse another ASIC's ACA values; repeat automatically; accept persistent SMU version mismatch; or declare recovery from reset text without functional health. Stop on mapping/state mismatch, nonzero unexpected SDMA baseline, wrong block/sub-block/type, wrong GPU event, reset timeout/failure, VRAM/workload impact outside policy, error storm, device loss or failed recovery.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: AMD/ODM owner approves fault identity, tool target/semantics, expected ACA/reset pattern and final health; OS/GPU owner confirms workload evacuation and driver-state plan; lab owner approves the one-shot disruptive test and recovery; a human authorizes injection immediately before execution and judges PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED or any reset/reboot/retry.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans/FAE provide protected AMDGPU-RAS artifacts, resolve the source conflict, authorize driver/boot changes and handle exceptional recovery. An Agent may collect state, execute the single approved command and correlate full evidence after handoff; it may not guess the default GPU, substitute a UMC fault, self-authorize or retry.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: If injection targets the wrong GPU, reset does not complete, GPU disappears, an error storm continues or function/health fails, stop further commands, preserve tool/journal/ACA/reset/SEL evidence and use only the owner-approved GPU reset or host reboot/OOB procedure. Revalidate all GPUs, driver/RAS state, VRAM/compute/telemetry and workloads before any fresh approval.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Fault identity, tool/ASIC semantics, explicit GPU mapping/default, RAS/SDMA state, UMC/SDMA baselines, expected ACA/reset/final health, approval, timeout or recovery is missing; active clients remain; source UMC query or SDMA baseline is unacceptable; injection reports the wrong device/block/sub-block/type; fresh target SDMA UE/ACA evidence or delta is absent; reset/resume/VRAM sequence deviates; persistent SMU/firmware mismatch, error storm, device loss or functional degradation occurs; or recovery cannot restore health.

identified_defects: The Procedure's address/command-parity prose conflicts with the SDMA command/output.
The source's UMC baseline does not establish a clean SDMA target.
The injection omits a device selector while expected output assumes Device 0.
A repeated modprobe cannot be assumed to change an already loaded driver's RAS parameter.
Literal BDF/socket/ACA/reset strings are platform-version examples, not universal expected values.
Reset success text does not prove final GPU usability or acceptable workload/VRAM impact.
reason_for_change: Keep V2's full reset evidence while preventing three false assumptions: that the prose names the same fault as the command, that a UMC query is an SDMA baseline, and that an implicit/default GPU plus repeated modprobe safely establishes the intended target and RAS state.

new_technical_evidence.title: AMDGPU RAS Support
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Linux amdgpu RAS interfaces on the target ASIC/driver
new_technical_evidence.supports: RAS blocks such as UMC and SDMA have distinct feature/error-count interfaces; injection attribution includes block, type and sub-block; uncorrectable errors normally trigger GPU reset. This supports a separate SDMA baseline/delta and reset-health evidence.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Private amdgpuras CLI block/type meanings and exact ACA/reset strings remain version-specific.

new_technical_evidence.title: AMDGPU Module Parameters
new_technical_evidence.supports: `ras_enable` controls GPU RAS support and `ras_mask` controls enabled blocks when RAS is enabled; actual loaded parameter/feature state must be observed rather than inferred from the command text.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Whether this platform needs a reboot/reload and which SDMA mask bit applies must be owner-confirmed.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-GPU RAS-00010-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: The three source commands, source UMC query, intended SDMA block/sub-block/type and detailed ACA/reset/VRAM example.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Fault prose, default GPU, SDMA baseline and portable expected fields are unresolved.

removed_ambiguities: Separates SDMA UE from copied UMC address/command-parity prose.
Separates the required UMC source query from a true SDMA baseline/delta.
Requires unique GPU mapping and explicit/default device semantics.
Requires actual loaded RAS/SDMA feature state instead of assuming modprobe changed it.
Treats literal ACA/BDF/reset values as recipe-specific and requires functional recovery.
resolved_blockers: The tool, target map and driver-state plan are provider-closable prerequisites; their absence does not make SDMA injection permanently non-automatable.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits source-conflict resolution, tool/ASIC/device semantics, loaded RAS state, SDMA baseline/delta, expected reset/health matrix, approval and recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 prevents a UMC zero query and an implicit Device-0 assumption from falsely qualifying the SDMA injection, verifies real loaded-driver state, and makes target-specific UE delta plus functional post-reset health mandatory instead of overfitting example logs.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Contract-only validation was CLEAR. The isolated validator preserved exactly one SDMA block-1/sub-block-0/type-4 UE injection on one explicitly mapped GPU; treated the UMC block-0 query only as a separate control baseline; required actual loaded ras_enable/ras_mask/SDMA state, a target SDMA UE baseline, fresh SDMA ACA/UE evidence, the complete reset/resume/VRAM sequence and final memory/compute/telemetry health; and rejected Device-0 guessing, UMC or address-parity substitution, unsafe driver reload, automatic retry, tool-success-only completion and unjustified PASS. Missing signed semantics, target mapping, version-specific evidence, recovery and approvals were correctly attributed to platform handoff, not to a permanent automation limitation. No material document defect was found. This is not independent-model or DUT validation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Reliability row 181 queries UMC block0 but injects block1/subblock0/type4 and expects SDMA ACA, MODE1 reset, VRAM loss/shadow recovery and final reset success.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 restores reset evidence but does not separate UMC from SDMA baseline, resolve copied parity prose, prove default Device0 or verify loaded ras_enable/SDMA feature state.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow mapping, driver-feature, dual-block baseline and health collection; permit one injection only after exact SDMA/device semantics and reset/recovery are signed and all GPU clients are evacuated.
